thread:
dave: FYI seeing a spike in streaming handshake timeouts right after the 1.3.0 canary push to us-west (~8%). Clients failing to start streaming sessions, lots of 408-ish logs.

incident-bot: INCIDENT created: INC-2026-042 (streaming-handshake-timeout) — severity: high — auto-detected by surge policy :rotating_light:

sara: I'm oncall and looking now. Paging @tim (eng-runtime) and @jess (release). Any quick mitigation ideas?

tim: pulling logs. looks like the client header version bump (`x-client-proto: 2`) in 1.3.0 isn't being accepted by some older runtime code paths — server returns handshake timeout after ~2s. reproducer: `grpc stream start -> handshake request -> no ACK -> client times out`.

dave: throwing a sample log:```
[2026-03-15T15:02:11Z] conn=abcd handshake start client=acmeproto/2
[2026-03-15T15:02:13Z] conn=abcd handshake timeout waiting for ACK
[2026-03-15T15:02:13Z] stream_id=xyz error=handshake_timeout code=408
```

jess: ugh. this is the compatibility gap we missed in the streaming contract tests. rollouts are at 8% only canary but customer-facing. plan: kill the handshake-v2 feature-flag and rollback the canary to v1.2.9.

deploy-bot: Rollout change requested: undo deployment sdk-service from v1.3.0 -> v1.2.9. Starting rollback in us-west canary pool. (cmd: `kubectl rollout undo deployment/sdk-service --to-revision=v1.2.9 --namespace=prod-us-west`)

oncall-sre: Executing kill-switch: `redwood ff kill sdk-stream-handshake-v2 --env=prod` — will cut traffic to v2 logic within 30s.

dave: quick impact estimate: ~5% of streaming sessions are failing right now, affects both hosted and some Dedicated customers on older SDKs. Customers reporting retries and partial transcripts. Not seeing data exfil or backend errors otherwise.

maria: I'll coordinate customer comms with CS and open a bridging doc. Affected customers so far: AcmePayments (partial failures), Bookly (retries causing slow UX). Will create support tickets and patch messages.

tim: quick mitigation notes: patch in-flight — add backward-compat acceptor for `x-client-proto: 2` -> fallback to v1 handshake logic; increase handshake timeout to 10s while we validate. Building hotfix branch now: `git checkout -b hotfix/stream-handshake-compat`

jess: agree. we'll let rollback finish and then cut 1.3.1 (hotfix) after smoke tests. monterror and streaming/connect metrics for 30m post-rollback.

incident-bot: Rollback completed in us-west canary pool at 15:18 UTC. Traffic anchored to v1.2.9.

tim: after rollback error rate dropped ~90% within 2 minutes. still seeing occasional retries from long-lived clients — those should recover after reconnect.

sara: Handoff — I'm passing primary to maria at 16:10 UTC. Maria will own customer comms and follow-on hotfix validation. Remaining action items: (1) hotfix PR + cut 1.3.1 (owner: tim/jess), (2) postmortem and test gap remediation (owner: dave), (3) customer messages + CS triage (owner: maria).

maria: ack — taking it. I'll post a short status update to #general and start the incident bridge notes. Will loop in account teams for top-affected customers.

dave: thanks all. we'll keep this thread live until 1.3.1 is validated in canary and customer impact is cleared. Follow-up: add a streaming-handshake compatibility test to the CI matrix (matrix include old-sdk v1 client + new server). :white_check_mark:

maria: noted. will collect logs for AcmePayments and create follow-up tickets. tagging for PM/QA: @jess @tim for hotfix, @dave for postmortem.

incident-bot: Incident INC-2026-042 status: mitigated -> monitoring. Will auto-close if no regression within 4h.

maria: closing the handoff — i'll post a timeline and owners in the bridge doc in 15m and start customer outreach. :phone:
